evidence: Two classification systems in model-router: task shapes (11 shapes mapping to capability descriptors) and context types (6 types for ContextTuner parameter selection). Task shapes: code, review, research, spec, debug, plan, test, document, visual, multi-target, agent. Context types: spec-authoring (temp=0.30), code-generation (temp=0.20), security-review (temp=0.50), planning (temp=0.60), synthesis (temp=0.80), administrative (temp=0.20). No chaotic type (G0DM0D3 chaotic has 66.7% precision; misclassifies code tasks with delete/break). Confidence scoring: current message 3x, last 4 history 1x each. If confidence <0.6: blend with planning baseline. Learned params from .wabblespec/memory/learned-params/ applied when sample_count >=3 and FRESH/AGING.
